PRODUCTS.name: Murano Glass Owls
PRODUCTS.desc: A pair of hand-blown glass owls in amber, ink and speckled white. Each is shaped and coloured by hand, so no two carry exactly the same markings.
details: Set of two hand-blown glass figures
Each piece is individually made and unique
PRODUCTS.care: Dust with a soft dry cloth. Wipe with a slightly damp cloth if needed and dry at once. Keep away from sharp changes in temperature.

PRODUCTS.name: Golden Lattice Potiches
PRODUCTS.desc: A pair of pierced ceramic potiches glazed in mirror gold, with lids. The open lattice throws a scatter of light across the surface they stand on.
details: Set of two potiches with lids
PRODUCTS.care: Dust with a soft brush to reach inside the lattice. Avoid abrasive cloths and cleaners, which can dull the gold glaze.

PRODUCTS.name: Heritage Jewellery Frames
PRODUCTS.desc: Traditional silver jewellery mounted on black and set in deep champagne-silver frames — two heirloom pieces presented as art.
PRODUCTS.care: Dust the frame with a dry cloth. Clean the glass with a cloth lightly sprayed with glass cleaner — never spray onto the frame directly.

PRODUCTS.name: Gilded Fish Sculptures
PRODUCTS.dims: H 33 × W 23 cm · H 28 × W 20 cm
PRODUCTS.desc: Two antique-gold fish, worked all over in raised spirals, each poised on a slim rod above a black base. Sold as a pair in two sizes.
details: Set of two sculptures on stands
PRODUCTS.care: Dust with a soft dry brush. Do not use water or metal polish on the gilded finish.

PRODUCTS.name: Blue Floral Porcelain Set
PRODUCTS.desc: A blue-and-white floral vase and a scalloped footed bowl, both mounted on ornate antique-bronze bases. Made to be shown together on a console or dining table.
PRODUCTS.care: Wipe the porcelain with a damp cloth. Keep the bronze mounts dry and dust them with a soft brush.

PRODUCTS.name: Floral Porcelain Vase
PRODUCTS.desc: A hand-painted porcelain ewer-vase in blue and amber florals, with a gently flared lip and a sculpted handle.
PRODUCTS.care: Wipe with a damp cloth. Not suitable for the dishwasher.

PRODUCTS.name: Brass Lampadaire
PRODUCTS.desc: A turned brass lamp with a pleated cream shade — a warm, steady light for a reading corner or a console.
PRODUCTS.care: Dust the brass with a dry cloth. Unplug before cleaning.

PRODUCTS.name: French Wall Plate
PRODUCTS.desc: A decorative porcelain plate in the French manner, painted with a ring of blue and gold florals.
details: Ready to hang or display on a stand
PRODUCTS.care: Wipe with a soft damp cloth. Decorative use only.

PRODUCTS.name: Ornate Jardinière
PRODUCTS.desc: A painted porcelain jardinière with twin gilded handles — for flowers, fruit, or to stand empty as a sculpture.
PRODUCTS.care: Wipe with a damp cloth. Use a liner when planting directly.

PRODUCTS.name: Bronze Candelabra
PRODUCTS.desc: A pair of turned candlesticks in warm bronze, tall enough to lift the flame above the table.
PRODUCTS.care: Remove wax once cool with a soft cloth. Dust with a dry cloth.
